thesis: Patrick Collison argues that the paradigm of programming has not evolved significantly over the past 20 years and that the ideal development environment should allow developers to read, think, and write code simultaneously within a single interactive loop. He illustrates this by describing how Smalltalk's ability to inspect stack frames and resume execution mid-request eliminated the frustrating feedback loop of traditional debugging, a capability he prioritized over using mainstream languages for his first startup.
